    Bug 1968913 - Open filter log as dependent, not modal dialog. r=mkmelin
    
    
    Having this opened as modal window doesn't seem necessary. Furthermore, this
    avoids an error about accessing the sessionHistory of remote browsers not being
    done in content scripts.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253792

diff --git a/mail/base/content/FilterListDialog.js b/mail/base/content/FilterListDialog.js
index 6d47c3e2ee7..9a269e61915 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/FilterListDialog.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/FilterListDialog.js
@@ -676,7 +676,7 @@ function viewLog() {
   window.openDialog(
     "chrome://messenger/content/viewLog.xhtml",
     "FilterLog",
-    "chrome,modal,titlebar,resizable,centerscreen",
+    "chrome,dependent,titlebar,resizable,centerscreen",
     args
   );
 }
title: Bug 1968913 - Open filter log as dependent, not modal dialog. r=mkmelin
